subject.title: fix(sessions): preserve parent lifecycle for parallel children

question: Should `sessions.create` permanently expose `succeedsParent` as the public lifecycle contract, with omission preserving legacy rollover and `false` representing a parallel child?
rationale: The parameter changes the meaning of parent-linked session creation for plugins, external SDK callers, and mixed-version clients; code review cannot choose the durable public lifecycle contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt explicit disposition
options.body: Approve the additive `succeedsParent` contract, retain legacy omission behavior, and require direct Codex plus client-coverage verification before merge.

options.title: Use a different public model
options.body: Request a narrower or differently named lifecycle API/default before landing if the team does not want callers to own succession semantics.

options.title: Defer protocol expansion
options.body: Keep the existing consumer-side protection and postpone a generic producer contract until lifecycle ownership is designed centrally.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit disposition
recommendation.body: Approve the additive `succeedsParent` contract, retain legacy omission behavior, and require direct Codex plus client-coverage verification before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The related lifecycle discussion names BunsDev as the likely provenance contact for this contract.
